findings.title: Allow validated fallback after an incomplete base cross-grade
findings.trigger: A trusted review reaches attempt 2 with the head-side checker complete but the required base checker incomplete, followed by a valid owner-approved independent fallback for that same head and base.
findings.execution_path: The runner returns failure when the base cross-grade fails. codex-fallback.cjs computes the combined review as incomplete and accepts its fallback. acceptance-readiness.cjs calls codexStatusFor(), which returns at lines 96–98 before reaching validateFallback().
findings.consequence: The documented recovery path remains blocked even after successful fallback validation and owner approval. A base-checker execution failure or incompatible checker upgrade can prevent acceptance indefinitely.
findings.evidence: An in-memory reproduction using a bound head-side complete status, attempt 2, a base-side incomplete status, and a valid fallback printed 'fallback valid' with validator exit 0, then readiness returned ok:false with 'the base commit’s checker did not confirm completeness'. Plan 85-14 requires incomplete trusted runs to use the shared fallback validator. The existing changed-grader test supplies no fallback, so all 146 targeted tests pass without detecting this case.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat a missing or incomplete required base grade as combined incompleteness and continue into fallback validation. Preserve rejection of mismatched evidence identities. Add a regression asserting that the validator and readiness agree for attempt 2 with an incomplete base grade and valid fallback, while no fallback still blocks.
